subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should Trim OS local Gateway pairing be handled as a core Gateway compatibility/diagnostic repair, an external package config-management issue, or a maintainer-approved auth-policy change?
rationale: The evidence points to a 1002 protocol mismatch path, but the requested workaround touches Gateway auth and device-pairing boundaries while the package that allegedly rewrites config is not in this source tree.

options.title: Collect proof before changing auth
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the first `connect` frame including protocol range and client metadata, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after regenerated config before choosing a code or package fix.

options.title: Narrow core diagnostics repair
options.body: If the logs show current OpenClaw clients produce opaque protocol/auth failures, improve Gateway/CLI diagnostics and docs without relaxing pairing or shared auth.

options.title: Route package config rewrite externally
options.body: If the only reproducible problem is `trim.openclaw` restoring `gateway.auth`, keep core defaults unchanged and route the config-management behavior to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before changing auth
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the first `connect` frame including protocol range and client metadata, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after regenerated config before choosing a code or package fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest inspected history across Gateway protocol compatibility, websocket auth logging, and device pairing approval surfaces.
